title: Wonderful Baking Dish
text: Wonderful Baking Dish. This is a wonderful baking dish. I like the red color. It's more of a reddish/orange color than a fire engine red. The sides are a little higher than my traditional 8x13 baking dish. The quality is good. It seems sturdy. The capacity is as expected. I am curious to see what other items are in this collection.

product_metadata.title: Ayesha Curry Ceramics Baking Dish/Lasagna Bakeware Pan, Rectangular, 9 Inch x 13 -Inch, Mustard
features: MODERN CLASSIC: Stylish design meets kitchen versatility in this roomy rectangular ceramic baking dish from Ayesha Curry
NONSTICK THROUGHOUT: Matte glazed finish is naturally nonstick, stain-resistant, and dishwasher safe for effortless food release and easy cleaning
VERSATILE CONSTRUCTION: Ceramic baker is safe for use in the microwave, freezer, oven, and dishwasher
QUICK CLEANUP: Ceramic stoneware baking dish is ideal for use as a lasagna pan or for desserts like berry cobbler and is dishwasher safe for easy cleaning
HEAT IT UP: Get beautiful browned results with this ceramic baker that's oven safe to 450°F
description: Pull together some easy weeknight Picante Chicken Enchiladas or make your next baked mac and cheese a household hit with the Ayesha Collection 9-Inch x 13-Inch Ceramic Rectangular Baker. A stylish profile gives this baker just the right accent of chic, table-ready design, while the large cooking area offers plenty of room for family-sized meals. High-quality, durable ceramic heats foods evenly and features a stain-resistant glazed finish for nonstick baking and matte exterior for cool countertop style. This large casserole dish works perfectly as a lasagna pan and is oven safe to 450°F, as well as microwave, freezer and dishwasher safe for convenience and versatility.
